lira.name: Lyra
lira.fallback: Commander, here is today's event. Check the card below!

no_comms.title: No signal!
no_comms.text: After yesterday's flare there is no contact with Earth. No forecast either.
no_comms.why: X-class flares cause strong radio interference.

QUIET.title: A quiet day
QUIET.text: The Sun is calm. Only weak background radiation today.

M.title: Class {detail} flare
M.text: A strong but ordinary flare on the Sun.

X.title: Class {detail} flare
X.text: A very powerful flare: its light reaches us in 8 minutes. No contact with Earth tomorrow.

X5.title: Class {detail} flare
X5.text: An extreme flare! No contact with Earth tomorrow.

CME.title: A particle cloud has arrived (CME)
CME.text: A CME is a giant cloud of particles thrown out by the Sun. It took 1–3 days to reach us.

EXTREME.title: Extreme magnetic storm
EXTREME.text: The strongest particle cloud in about 20 years has arrived!

SEP.title: Radiation storm
SEP.text: A stream of super-fast particles from the Sun. The most dangerous thing for astronauts!

forecast.heading: Forecast
forecast.clear: No solar particle clouds in sight for the next few days.
forecast.unavailable: No forecast: contact with Earth is lost.
forecast.cme_tomorrow: A cloud of solar particles arrives tomorrow!

cme.one: A cloud of solar particles arrives in {n} day!
cme.other: A cloud of solar particles arrives in {n} days!

source.real_event: Real event from the NASA archive
